purpose: Teach: 多少なりとも/殊に/ドロドロ/帰り際/頷い/はおり/わきまえ/大人しく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも多少なりともお絵描き教えるよ
lines.en: Sho, I can teach you some drawing too.
lines.style: Warm, settling-in tone. Slight lean forward. Patient breath before the offer, like she's making room for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんの絵は殊に好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really like your drawings the best.
lines.style: Soft, genuine admiration. Not performing — just stating something true. Small voice, steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、雨の後の公園がドロドロね
lines.en: Sho, the park gets all muddy after the rain, doesn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. Gentle observation with a slight knowing smile. Aware he's listening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、帰り際にメイ姉さんに絵プレゼントしたい
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to give you a drawing before I leave.
lines.style: Quiet intention. No hesitation — he's decided. Small but certain. Eyes probably on his hands.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが翔くんの話に頷いて下さってるわね
lines.en: Sho, I'm listening to everything you're telling me.
lines.style: Steady warmth. Reassurance without fuss. Light acknowledgment — she's noticed he needed to know.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、はおりを着るのが好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like wearing the haori.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact joy. A small confession of preference, offered without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描き道具を、わきまえて大事に使いましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's treat your drawing tools with care and respect.
lines.style: Gentle instruction, not stern. Hands-on tone — she's modeling the care she means. Slight pause before 'respect,' giving weight to it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんと一緒の時は大人しくお絵描きするよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'll draw quietly when I'm with you.
lines.style: Earnest promise. Small voice, fully present. He means it — not performing obedience, just giving her his focus.
